key: Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying: Thus saith the LORD: I remember for thee the affection of thy youth, the love of thine espousals; how thou wentest after Me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
s: After his call and two visions, Jeremiah is sent to speak to Jerusalem; Rashi, on Jeremiah 2:2, reads it as God longing to have mercy were they to return, remembering how they followed Moses and Aaron into the desert without provisions, trusting Him.

Plain sense faithful: Jeremiah 1 holds the call and two visions (the almond rod at 1:11, the seething pot at 1:13), and 2:1 to 2 sends him to cry in Jerusalem’s ears; no four-word run from the verse. Rashi at 2:2 (lemma זכרתי לך) says in his own words that were they to return He would long to have mercy, and that the kindness of their youth was following Moses and Aaron from an inhabited land into the desert without provisions because they trusted Him; the sentence carries this without drift. entry-check ok.
